title: Harmonic-adapted Hodge splitting replaces raw flat-holonomy radius cost by variation and curvature remainder

harmonic_split.decomposition: In periodic Coulomb gauge write A=a+A_perp with a the spatial mean, mean(A_perp)=0 and div(A_perp)=0; use D_a in the principal charged energy.
harmonic_split.hodge_control: For the mean-zero divergence-free remainder, torus Hodge/Poincare gives ||A_perp||_(H^(s+1))<=C_s||curl A||_(H^s), while ||partial_t A_perp||_(H^s)<=||E_perp||_(H^s).
harmonic_split.remainder_budget: The adapted hierarchy replaces |e|||a|| by a schematic integrable coefficient C_s[(|e|/m)|dot a|+|e|||curl A||_(H^s)+|e|||E_perp||_(H^s)+controlled nonlinear current/radial terms].
harmonic_split.conditional_radius: If the adapted coercive hierarchy closes and the displayed remainder is L1_t with integral smaller than the available initial-radius margin, then rho(t) stays bounded below by a positive limit.
harmonic_split.structural_advance: Static flat holonomy consumes no radius; evolving holonomy is charged only through a continuous lift's total variation, and mean-zero potential size is replaced by curvature/electric control.
harmonic_split.scope_guard: No coupled estimate proves the harmonic electric variation, oscillatory curvature, current feedback or radial remainder integrable. The nonlinear global flow and positive limiting radius remain conditional.
